refuse_when.message: Taiwan labour and employment insurance turn on the worker’s age: record the date of birth.

configuration.limitation: Insured on the grade of the contract’s monthly wage (base salary with its fixed allowances), or the declared insured_amount — never re-graded from a month’s reduced pay; 12.5%, 11.5% for a worker covered by employment insurance under 65 (就業保險法 §41(2)); prorated by covered days on a 30-day month (勞工保險條例施行細則 §27; BLI 分擔金額表 by 投保日數), days on 育嬰留職停薪 left out (性別平等工作法 §16(2): the employer share is waived, the worker’s deferred); nothing in a unit of fewer than five workers that never entered compulsory cover (company.facts.li_no_insurance_unit; 勞工保險條例 §6, §8); after 65 only with the election continued_after_65; the worker’s share reduced by the election disability_subsidy (身心障礙者權益保障法 §73). FIXED_ROUND7

references.title: Labor Insurance Act articles 6, 8, 9, 13–15; Enforcement Rules articles 27, 28-1 and 33. Ordinary-risk premium rate 11.5%, shared 20% employee, 70% employer and 10% government. Registered continuing cover remains chargeable after age 65. Apply the declared insured salary grade and covered days on a thirty-day calendar; round each share once after day proration. Variable wages use an independently recorded three-month-average declaration. Salary changes do not automatically change the insured grade; notified adjustments take effect on the first of the following month. Sources: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0007758.html ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0014162.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0005472.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006928.html 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73 — the government subsidises the insured worker's own share by the certificate's severity (100/50/25%); BLI computes the subsidy on the worker's unrounded share and rounds it to the whole dollar on its own, and the worker is withheld the rounded share less the rounded subsidy — BLI's worked example (勞動部勞工保險局納保組 許晉慶, 〈身心障礙勞工保險費減免〉, 台灣勞工季刊 第44期 p.72–73, https://www.mol.gov.tw/media/q5cjfwu3/%E6%B4%BB%E7%94%A8%E6%B3%95%E8%A6%8F.pdf): 輕度, grade 28,800, LI 9%: (28,800×9%×20%) − (28,800×9%×20%×25%) = 518 − 130 = 388; EI 1%: 58 − 14 = 44. Subsidy standards 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法 §4–5 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?PCode=D0050090). The employer share is unchanged.

name: 積欠工資墊償基金 (wage arrears payment fund)

configuration.limitation: 0.025% of the worker’s 墊償提繳薪資 — the LI grade (or the insurer-confirmed grade declared as the LI election insured_amount) prorated by covered days on a 30-day month, 育嬰留職停薪 days left out — the assessment, carried as the slip’s charged_base. Each slip shows its own share rounded to the dollar as an estimate (BLI: 計費清單所列墊償提繳薪資…是估算值); BLI bills 0.025% of the unit’s total, rounded once (並非按個別員工之投保薪資分別計算再加總), so the remittance (INSURANCE_PREMIUM_REMITTANCE) prices the levy on run.statutory WAGE_ARREARS_FUND charged_base.

references.title: Labor Standards Act article 28. Sum all covered workers’ prorated LI-equivalent insured salaries, including workers covered only by employment or occupational accident insurance, then apply 0.025% and round once to the nearest whole dollar at company level. Source:

Priced on the wage’s LI grade (1%; 20% worker, 70% employer). The insurer-confirmed grade, where declared as the LI election insured_amount, replaces the grade of the wage. Graded on the monthly wage, prorated by covered days and left out on 育嬰留職停薪 days, as LI (就業保險法 §40).

references.title: Employment Insurance Act articles 5, 8 and 40; Labor Insurance Act article 15; Enforcement Rules article 28-1. Apply the independently declared insured grade and covered days on a thirty-day calendar, rounding each share once after proration. Notified grade adjustments take effect on the first of the following month. Sources: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0014162.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0005472.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006928.html 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73 — the government subsidises the insured worker's own share by the certificate's severity (100/50/25%); BLI computes the subsidy on the worker's unrounded share and rounds it to the whole dollar on its own, and the worker is withheld the rounded share less the rounded subsidy — BLI's worked example (勞動部勞工保險局納保組 許晉慶, 〈身心障礙勞工保險費減免〉, 台灣勞工季刊 第44期 p.72–73, https://www.mol.gov.tw/media/q5cjfwu3/%E6%B4%BB%E7%94%A8%E6%B3%95%E8%A6%8F.pdf): 輕度, grade 28,800, LI 9%: (28,800×9%×20%) − (28,800×9%×20%×25%) = 518 − 130 = 388; EI 1%: 58 − 14 = 44. Subsidy standards 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法 §4–5 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?PCode=D0050090). The employer share is unchanged. BLI eligibility and document classification: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0007747.html coverage cannot precede the fifteenth birthday (art.5); apply the later of declared cover and birthday. name: National Health Insurance (全民健康保險)

rules.when:
has(leave.rows)
&&leave.rows.exists(
  r,
  r.code in ["PARENTAL_LEAVE", "PARENTAL_LEAVE_BY_DAY"]
  &&r.activity == "TIME_OFF"
  && (r.to == null ? r.from : r.to) >= period.month_to
  &&r.from <= period.month_to
)

configuration.limitation: Charged for the whole month by the unit insuring the worker on its last day (全民健康保險法 §30; NHIA 保險費計收: 當月最末日在保): nothing in a month the worker left before its last day, a whole month for a joiner; nothing where the last day falls in 育嬰留職停薪 (§16(2) 性別平等工作法; the worker’s share is deferred). Graded on the monthly wage or the declared insured_amount. Worker 30% per person for self (less the election disability_subsidy) and up to three enrolled dependants; employer 60% × 1.56.

references.title: National Health Insurance Act articles 18, 27, 29 and 30; Enforcement Rules article 52. Regular premiums use the declared insured amount at the month-end insuring unit. The employee pays 30% of the 5.17% premium for self and up to three enrolled dependants; published whole-dollar per-person premiums apply. The employer pays 60% with the published 1.56 average dependant factor. The declaration is independent of contract salary and retains its effective dates. 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73 and 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法 §4–5 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?PCode=D0050090) — the government pays 100% (極重度/重度), 50% (中度) or 25% (輕度) of a disabled person's own premium; 全民健康保險法 §27(1)(1) makes each dependant's 30% their own (被保險人及其眷屬自付), so each disabled dependant's per-person premium is subsidised on its own (elections `disability_subsidy`, `dependants_subsidised_*`). 全民健康保險法施行細則 §52: premiums are paid in whole dollars, 角以下四捨五入, and where the self-paid premium and the government subsidy both end in five 角 the subsidy rounds up (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=L0060002) — so each person's subsidy is round(per-person premium × share, 1, 'HALF_UP') and the worker pays the rest. The supplementary premium is outside the subsidy: 補助辦法 §4–5 subsidise the insured person's own 自付保險費, and NHIA applies it by deducting it in the monthly premium billing (健保費開計作業中予以扣減補助 — NHIA 各級政府辦理保險對象健保費補助項目一覽表, updated 115-09-17, https://www.nhi.gov.tw/ch/cp-4721-0d598-2645-1.html); the §31 supplementary premium is withheld at the payment, not billed there, so it carries none (inference from the two; the former municipal citation replaced 2026-09-28). Sources: https://www.nhi.gov.tw/en/cp-68-8652f-35-2.html ; https://www.nhi.gov.tw/ch/cp-4516-74b0f-2613-1.html (URLs corrected 2026-09-28; both open)

name: 健保補充保險費 (NHI supplementary premium)

configuration.limitation: 2.11% on the part of the year’s bonuses above four times the insured grade of the month’s salary (the ordinary wage counted here); the grade is the contract wage’s, so a bonus paid off-cycle before the month’s salary is charged in full when it is paid. The NHI election insured_amount, where declared, is the insured amount the four-times threshold reads.

references.title: National Health Insurance Act article 31: bonuses exceeding four times the current insured amount attract a 2.11% supplementary premium, limited to the current payment and NT$10 million of assessable bonus per payment. After departure, retain the insured amount at withdrawal. The regular month-end premium being zero does not remove this threshold. Round once to whole NT dollars. Sources: https://www.nhi.gov.tw/ch/cp-2985-e7319-3150-1.html ; https://www.nhi.gov.tw/ch/dl-64814-5f26c2b955c24ebbbbf1479877ecfb7e-1.pdf the bonus is every class counting toward this scheme (`ALLOWANCES + ADHOC`, the year's in `year.ALLOWANCES + year.ADHOC`), never a company's code.

name: 健保補充保險費—兼職薪資所得 (NHI supplementary premium on part-time salary)

rules.when:
(("NHI" in elections && has(elections.NHI.insured_elsewhere)
&&elections.NHI.insured_elsewhere == true)
||lines.exists(
  l,
  l.code in ["NON_COMPETE_COMPENSATION", "NON_COMPETE_LUMP_SUM"]
))
&&!(has(scheme.elections.exempt) && scheme.elections.exempt == true)
rules.employee:
(has(charged.month.NHI_PART_TIME)
  ?charged.month.NHI_PART_TIME.employee
  :0.0)
+sum((
  [
    sum(
      lines.filter(
        l,
        l.code
        in [
          "BASIC",
          "NO_PAY_LEAVE",
          "PARTIAL_PAY_LEAVE",
          "SUSPENSION_DEDUCTION",
          "FULL_ATTENDANCE_BONUS",
          "MEAL_TAXABLE_EXCESS",
          "OVERTIME_TAXABLE_EXCESS",
          "NON_COMPETE_COMPENSATION"
        ]
      ).map(
        l,
        l.amount
      )
    )
  ]
  +lines.filter(
    l,
    l.code in ["bonus", "ENCASHMENT", "NON_COMPETE_LUMP_SUM"]
  ).map(
    l,
    l.amount
  )).map(
    p,
    p >= 28590.0
      ?round(min(p, 10000000.0) * 0.0211, 1.0, "HALF_UP")
      :0.0
  )
)

configuration.limitation: Each payment to a worker not insured through this unit — the slip’s salary income as one payment (所得稅法 §14 薪資所得: the exempt NT$3,000 of a meal allowance and overtime within the §32 limits left out), each bonus or leave-pay line as its own — charged whole at 2.11% when it reaches the NT$28,590 minimum wage, at most NT$10,000,000 a payment. Non-compete compensation paid after the exit is salary to a person no longer insured through this unit, so it is charged here whatever the NHI election (owner ruling: salary income).

references.title: 全民健康保險法 §31(1)(2): salary income (薪資所得, 所得稅格式代號 50) paid to a person who is not insured through this unit (兼職薪資所得) attracts the 2.11% supplementary premium, withheld at payment by the payer (§31(1) 扣費義務人). NHIA, 二代健保補充保險費簡介 (115.01.05 版, https://www.nhi.gov.tw/ch/dl-26429-47de962ef1464d8f91828d4421028290-1.pdf): the rate is 2.11% from 1 January 2021; from 1 September 2014 a single payment below the basic (minimum) wage is not withheld on, so a payment at or above the NT$28,590 minimum wage is charged whole; a single payment is assessed on at most NT$10,000,000; 第2類 insureds’ salary income and persons with no NHI eligibility or 第5類 insureds are exempt (the NHI_PART_TIME election exempt). A worker insured through this unit (the NHI election insured_elsewhere unset) is outside this premium; their bonus premium is NHI_SUPPLEMENT. Each payslip is one payment (PAY_PERIOD). Rounded to the whole NT dollar (四捨五入; NHIA 補充保險費計算公式 page, not retrieved — secondary sources agree).

name: Labor Pension (勞工退休金, new system)

refuse_when.message: Record the residency status (CITIZEN, PERMANENT_RESIDENT or FOREIGNER) on the employment terms.

configuration.limitation: The employer rate (scheme.elections.employer_rate, at least 6) and the worker’s voluntary rate (the election voluntary_rate, up to 6) on the 月提繳工資分級表 grade the wage falls in, for nationals, permanent residents and foreign spouses; nothing for a worker who kept the LSA pension (the election pension_system LSA). The insurer-confirmed grade, where declared as its own election insured_amount, replaces the grade of the wage. Contributed from the day of joining to the day of leaving by days on a 30-day month (勞工退休金條例 §16), stopped on 育嬰留職停薪 days (§20), on the grade of the monthly wage. A voluntary rate above 6 is held at 6 (勞工退休金條例 §14(3): 每月工資百分之六範圍內).

references.title: Labor Pension Act articles 7–9, 14, 15 and 18. The employer contributes at least 6% of the declared monthly contribution wage (scheme.elections.employer_rate, default 6; §14(1) 不得低於 6%, so a higher declared rate is priced as declared). A national continuously employed by the same unit before 1 July 2005 may retain the LSA old pension system under articles 8–9, with the 2005 election or deemed continuation and same-unit history evidenced by the nonregistration declaration; the LSA section 56 employer reserve still applies. An employee may voluntarily contribute up to 6%; the default is no voluntary contribution. Apply the declared grade and covered days on a thirty-day month, rounding after proration. A February departure on the last day completes thirty contribution days. Sources: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0017599.html ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0005472.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0102559.html ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0022156.html

name: Occupational Accident Insurance (勞工職業災害保險)

refuse_when.message: Taiwan occupational accident insurance is priced on the entity’s industry class: record the entity’s risk class (1–55, 勞工職業災害保險適用行業別及費率表).

configuration.limitation: The employer pays the 災保費率 (行業別 + 0.07% 上下班, 勞動部 113-11-07 公告, from 2025-01-01) of the entity’s risk class on the 勞工職業災害保險投保薪資分級表 grade the month’s wage falls in (28,590–72,800), every worker regardless of age or nationality, rounded to the dollar. A Bureau-notified experience rate (company.facts.occ_experience_rate_percent) replaces the table rate; prorated by covered days on a 30-day month, 育嬰留職停薪 days left out (性別平等工作法 §16(2)). The insurer-confirmed grade, where declared as its own election insured_amount, replaces the grade of the wage.

references.title: Labor Occupational Accident Insurance and Protection Act articles 16, 17 and 19; Enforcement Rules articles 2, 26 and 28. The employer pays the declared insured grade multiplied by the applicable industry and commuting rate and covered days divided by 30. Round the resulting premium once to whole NT dollars after day proration. The declared grade is effective independently of contract wage changes. Sources: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0106129.html ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/Files/24759 ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0014162.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0005472.htm An insured unit on an experience-rated industry rate (勞工職業災害保險及保護法 §16(4), 實績費率: the Bureau notifies the unit’s own rate each year) records the notified total rate, commuting rate included, as the registration’s rate override; otherwise the industry table rate applies.

configuration.limitation: Resident regular salary: with a declared 免稅額申報表 (election exemptions), the 114年度薪資所得扣繳稅額表 (財政部 113年12月 函發布; https://www.ntbca.gov.tw/download/f8e06fd841e74700aed593f8c9039ef9) — reproduced cell for cell by its own formula on the row’s lower bound (500-dollar rows to 500,000, tax rounded down to ten, nothing at 2,000 or less), and above 500,000 the 說明(三) formula on the salary itself; without one, 5% truncated with nothing at NT$2,000 or less (薪資所得扣繳辦法 §6–7, 各類所得扣繳率標準 §2(1)(1)). A worker whose salary here is 兼職所得 (election part_time_income) is withheld 5% of the slip’s salary (the 薪資所得 lines: exempt overtime and the exempt NT$3,000 of a meal allowance left out) when it reaches the NT$88,501 起扣標準 (薪資所得扣繳辦法 §7); a bonus or leave-pay line is withheld by INCOME_TAX_BONUS when it is paid. The voluntary labour pension contribution is taken out of the base (勞工退休金條例 §14(3)). Never deferred: on a slip paid before the month’s salary run (an off-cycle run), the month’s regular pay still to come (person.normal_pending: the contract’s monthly wage, by covered days on a 30-day month for a part month; nil once the salary run has paid or is paying it) is assessed with the payment and only the difference it makes is charged — tax(paid + pending) − tax(pending) — so the payment bears the tax its place in the month attracts; the salary run settles the month on what was actually paid.

wage_adjustments.name: Meal allowance above the NT$3,000 exemption (tax base)

references.title: 營利事業所得稅查核準則 §88(2)(1) (amended 2023-12-11): a meal allowance of up to NT$3,000 a month is not the employee’s salary income; the part above it is. MEAL_ALLOWANCE counts toward no withholding base; this EMPLOYER-destination line (a tax-base line, not paid) carries the excess into it. https://law-out.mof.gov.tw/LawContent.aspx?id=FL006027 The NT$3,000 is a month’s: a semi-monthly part exempts 3,000 ÷ its parts.

wage_adjustments.rate:
max(
  0.0,
  sum(
    terms.allowances.filter(a, a.code == "MEAL_ALLOWANCE").map(
      a,
      double(a.amount)
    )
  )
  /double(period.parts)
  *period.paid_days
  /period.days
  -3000.0 / double(period.parts)
)

wage_adjustments.name: Overtime pay above the §32 ceiling (tax base)

references.title: 所得稅法 §14(1) 第三類: 加班之延長工作時間…在勞動基準法規定之時數以內者…免稅 — overtime pay for the hours above the month’s 46 (54 with consent) is salary income. The pay is apportioned by hours (the month’s overtime pay × hours above the ceiling ÷ all overtime hours). An EMPLOYER-destination line: it moves the tax bases it counts toward and is not paid. Two consents (勞動基準法 §32(1)–(2)): the collective approval — the union, or the labour-management conference where there is none — dated, is the entity fact overtime_extension_approval_on with overtime_extension_approved_by, and alone lifts the 46-hour month to 54 and opens the 138 hours in three months; the worker’s own agreement to each day’s overtime is the day’s overtime_consented (owner ruling: per day), checked on the work-day import (ROSTER_OVERTIME_WITHOUT_CONSENT). Read on the month to date (work.month_days: the 1st through the period’s end), so a semi-monthly half sums the month. The month’s earlier parts’ excess (earned.month) is not taxed again.

references.title: 所得稅法 article 88; 各類所得扣繳率標準 article 2; 薪資所得扣繳辦法 articles 6–7. Resident regular salary is assessed on the full month's payments, separately from non-monthly bonus payments. The table method requires a dated declaration reference and the declared spouse/dependant count. Family records do not grant table exemptions. Without the declaration, article 6 requires 5%; an explicit 5% election also uses that method. The 5% method truncates tax to whole NT dollars before applying the NT$2,000 exemption; NT$40,020 is the first whole-dollar salary requiring withholding. The table method uses the 114年度 table (台財稅字第11304679670號函): NT$97,000 personal exemption, NT$262,000 married standard deduction and NT$218,000 salary deduction. Published salary bands truncate table tax to NT$10; salaries above NT$500,000 or more than eleven spouse/dependant exemptions use the annualised formula in explanation (3), truncated to NT$1. Current-month voluntary labour pension contributions are excluded once under 勞工退休金條例 article 14(4). Tax fractions below NT$1 are discarded under 各級公庫代理銀行代辦機構及代收稅款機構稅款解繳作業辦法 article 5 (https://law-out.mof.gov.tw/LawContent.aspx?id=FL051526). Tax residency must be declared on dated employment terms; citizenship does not determine residence. A mainland-area resident (大陸地區人民) is resident for withholding only on the stay test of 臺灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例 §25(2) and (4) (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=Q0010001&flno=25): 居留、停留合計滿一百八十三日 in the tax year takes the resident table or 5% method; under 183 days the payer withholds at payment at the non-resident salary rates (18%, or 6% up to 1.5 × the minimum wage), per §25(5)–(6) and the MOF answer NM11BZY (updated 115-04-10); no domicile route applies. Cited in place 2026-09-29 (a citation omission, same rule in every version); the declared residency must rest on that day count. https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw/etwmain/tax-info/understanding/tax-q-and-a/national/individual-income-tax/withheld-rule/rule/NM11BZY a bonus class counts toward INCOME_TAX_BONUS instead of this scheme, so the regular base carries no bonus to subtract.

configuration.limitation: Non-resident salary withheld at 6% up to 1.5 × the NT$28,590 minimum wage (NT$42,885), otherwise 18%, truncated. A foreigner is resident only from the recorded residency_since day. The band is the month’s whole salary, bonus included (各類所得扣繳率標準 §3(1)(1): 全月給付總額), so a bonus paid before the salary is withheld at the rate the month’s total attracts. Never deferred: on a slip paid before the month’s salary run (an off-cycle run), the month’s regular pay still to come (person.normal_pending: the contract’s monthly wage, by covered days on a 30-day month for a part month; nil once the salary run has paid or is paying it) is assessed with the payment and only the difference it makes is charged — tax(paid + pending) − tax(pending) — so the payment bears the tax its place in the month attracts; the salary run settles the month on what was actually paid.

references.title: 所得稅法 article 88 and 各類所得扣繳率標準 article 3(2): non-resident salary, including taxable allowances and bonuses, is assessed monthly at 6% when total monthly salary does not exceed 1.5 times the applicable minimum wage; otherwise 18%. The resident NT$2,000 exemption does not apply. Tax fractions below NT$1 are discarded under 各級公庫代理銀行代辦機構及代收稅款機構稅款解繳作業辦法 article 5 (https://law-out.mof.gov.tw/LawContent.aspx?id=FL051526). Cited in place 2026-09-29 (a citation omission, same rule in every version); the declared residency must rest on that day count. https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw/etwmain/tax-info/understanding/tax-q-and-a/national/individual-income-tax/withheld-rule/rule/NM11BZY the 6% band’s ceiling is one and a half times the minimum wage (各類所得扣繳率標準 §3(1)(1)), so the rule reads `1.5 * minimum_wage(person.company.region)` from the version’s own wage table rather than a transcribed figure (42,885 on 28,590; 44,250 on 29,500).

configuration.limitation: 全民健康保險法 §34: 2.11% of the month’s salary income paid by the unit (所得稅法 §14 第三類 薪資所得, bonuses included) above the total insured amounts of its insured — never negative. person.insured is the worker’s insured amount on the month’s last day (nil for a worker insured elsewhere, a leaver before the month’s end, or a former worker paid after leaving). It is the assessment (charged_base) only on the salary run’s slip, so a month’s insured amount is netted once however many runs pay the month, and the remittance (NHI_EMPLOYER_SUPPLEMENTARY_PREMIUM) nets run.statutory base against charged_base. Each slip shows the worker’s own share floored at nil; an off-cycle slip before the salary run adds the regular pay still to come (person.normal_pending) and charges only the difference its payment makes.

references.title: 全民健康保險法 §34: the insuring unit pays 2.11% of the excess of the month’s total salary income paid (薪資所得, 所得稅格式代號 50) over the total insured amounts of its insured (`produced.NHI.base` over the run), netted across the establishment, not person by person. Salary income excludes overtime within the 勞基法 §32 limits and the statutory unused-annual-leave pay (所得稅法 §14(1)(3); 財政部 74年台財稅第16713號), so only the over-limit overtime (`INCENTIVE`) enters; the worker’s voluntary labour-pension contribution is outside salary income (勞工退休金條例 §14(3)). references.title: 職工福利金條例 §2(1)(3) (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0040001&flno=2, last amended 2015-07-01): 每月於每個職員工人薪津內各扣百分之○‧五 — a worker deduction paid into the entity's 職工福利金, withheld only where the entity records `company.facts.welfare_committee_established` (§1 obliges every enterprise to 提撥 and 辦理職工福利事業; the deduction presupposes the committee and fund that receive it). Temporary workers are included (勞委會 93-02-17 勞福一字第0930006802號函). Owner rule 2026-09-28 defaults (law silent): 薪津 is the month's salary line net of unpaid days (`BASE - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE`), an allowance joining it only where its class lists WELFARE_FUND in `counts_toward`; the deduction is rounded to the 元 half up, as the insurance shares are. It is not excluded from 薪資所得 (所得稅法 §14(1) 第三類 lists no such exclusion), so no tax base subtracts it. The employer's own §2(1)(1)(2)(4) appropriations (capital, 0.05–0.15% of monthly revenue, 20–40% of scrap sales) are entity-level and outside payroll.
